name: base_utils
description: Shared operating-system utility module that optionally manages /etc/motd, installs configured utility packages, and provides custom Puppet types, functions, facts, plans, and service-check tasks.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Deploys a Python application from a repository, prepares PostgreSQL connectivity, renders environment and systemd configuration, and manages monitoring and logging components.

name: profile_haproxy
description: Configures an HAProxy load balancer with packages, generated frontend and backend configuration, optional service discovery, firewall handling, statistics, logging, and TLS support.

name: profile_postgresql
description: Installs and configures PostgreSQL, including PGDG repository management, version-specific packages, and service startup.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Configures Redis cluster nodes using the Puppet Redis module and PuppetDB-backed discovery, including authentication and memory settings.

name: profile composition layer
description: Provides thin profiles that compose base operating-system services, the application stack, HAProxy, and Redis cache functionality.

name: role composition layer
description: Provides node-role entrypoints that combine profiles for application servers, HAProxy nodes, Redis clusters, and related service compositions.

name: puppetdb_query_stub
description: Provides a custom Puppet function integration point for PuppetDB queries used by the Redis discovery design.
